announce-duplicate-capability.rationale: TypeScript Map indexing is last-wins; the .NET lane fails closed rather than route an ambiguous runtime announcement.
announce-duplicate-capability.source: README row: duplicate-announcement fail-closed vs last-wins

pack-spaced-range.rationale: The TypeScript range regex accepts whitespace after >= and <; the .NET parser intentionally requires compact comparison operands.

invoke-log-principal.rationale: The .NET wire model does not yet carry the TypeScript principal attribution field, so its log omits principal=<id>.
invoke-log-principal.source: README row: dropped principal= log field

m3-normalize-missing-retryable.rationale: The typed CLR wire model always carries retryable; the supplied bool is retained, while TypeScript defaults a missing bool from the normalized domain.
m3-normalize-missing-retryable.source: README row: error-half narrowing if retained

m3-normalize-error-domain-coercion.rationale: The CLR error record has a nullable retryAfter property on the typed wire model; TypeScript omits that optional field when it is absent.
